notes.title: New Game Mode - Raid
notes.notes: Introducing the highly anticipated raid feature, you will be able command multiple characters simultaneously, each armed with their own unique decks. Unleash the full spectrum of your tactical prowess as you orchestrate attacks and outsmart your opponents. This work in progress feature adds a layer of complexity and depth that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Prepare for an immersive journey where every decision matters, and victory depends on your ability to command a team with precision and skill.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.1
notes.notes:
- New Warrior Summon: Ballista (Summon a 6 Hp Ballista that deals piercing damage).
- New Ballista Skill: Throw Bolt (Inflict 4 piercing damage, ignores armour).
- Expedition: Blessings can be obtained from Elite Fights.
- Campaign battles can be completed once.
- Bugfixing.
